about_the_game:
The Bootsies demo features an appetizer for the main course: arcade mode, offline versus with limited characters, and online versus games so you can try Bootsies with your friends!

Demo includes:

  • 1 player: Arcade mode

  • 2 players (local): Offline VS with limited characters

  • 2 players (online): Online VS public or private (password-protected) games

Full game includes:

  • Everything in the demo, plus:

  • 1 player: Odyssey mode (Roguelite beat 'em up / fighting)

  • 1 player: Arcade mode online leaderboard, secrets

  • 2 players (local): Offline VS with all characters + Ruleset variations

  • 2 players (online): Online VS ranked games + Ranking system and leaderboard + King of the Cabinet mode

  • Unlockable extras (cosmetics, modes, secrets, lore, art, ???)

Bootsies is a pure 1D fighting game with a handmade retro aesthetic that emphasizes reading your opponent, precise spacing, and making bold moves to outplay opponents. Play as a colorful cast of cute boot-clad fighters determined to shape their planet's future. Steel-toe yourself and BOOT UP!

Bootsies is designed so that anyone can pick it up and start outplaying any opponent within minutes, but experienced players versed in fundamentals will stay endlessly engaged in intense battles rich with layers of spacing, reads, and adaptation.

Bootsies uses an intuitive button scheme with no directional inputs! That means you can even play this game one-handed!

The core of the gameplay is built around the neutral triangle structure common to all fighting games. Bootsies hones in on this tense dance of rock-paper-scissors at its very heart, and takes it to new depths!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250 CPU @ 1.60 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Preferably
  • VR Support: Nope
  • Additional Notes: Wifi is ok if you're close to the router
